import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int mod = sc.nextInt();

        ModularInteger.setMod(mod);

        // Compute binomial coefficients
        ModularInteger[][] C = new ModularInteger[n + 1][n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            C[i][0] = ModularInteger.ONE;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j - 1].add(C[i - 1][j]);
            }
        }

        // Precompute g array
        ModularInteger[] g = new ModularInteger[n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            g[i] = ModularInteger.valueOf(i).multiply(i + 1).divide(2);
        }

        // f array: pair (pattern, sum of madness of all pattern)
        Pair[] f = new Pair[n + 1];
        f[0] = new Pair(ModularInteger.ONE, ModularInteger.ZERO);
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            ModularInteger patternSum = ModularInteger.ZERO;
            ModularInteger madnessSum = ModularInteger.ZERO;
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                ModularInteger z = f[j].pattern.multiply(f[i - 1 - j].pattern).multiply(C[i - 1][j]);
                patternSum = patternSum.add(z.multiply(i + 1));
                madnessSum = madnessSum.add(z.multiply(g[j].add(g[i - 1 - j])));
                ModularInteger term = (f[i - 1 - j].pattern.multiply(f[j].madness).add(f[j].pattern.multiply(f[i - 1 - j].madness)))
                        .multiply(C[i - 1][j]).multiply(i + 1);
                madnessSum = madnessSum.add(term);
            }
            f[i] = new Pair(patternSum, madnessSum);
        }

        // DP array: dp[l][i] = pair (patterns, madness)
        Pair[][] dp = new Pair[n + 2][m + 1];
        dp[0][0] = new Pair(ModularInteger.ONE, ModularInteger.ZERO);
        for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
            for (int r = 0; r <= n + 1; r++) {
                for (int l = 0; l <= r - 1; l++) {
                    int di = r - l - 1;
                    for (int j = i; j + di <= m; j++) {
                        Pair from = dp[l][j];
                        if (from == null) continue;
                        ModularInteger z = from.pattern.multiply(f[di].pattern);
                        if (dp[r][j + di] == null) {
                            dp[r][j + di] = new Pair(z.multiply(C[j + di][di]), from.madness.multiply(f[di].pattern).add(from.pattern.multiply(f[di].madness).multiply(C[j + di][di])));
                        } else {
                            Pair existing = dp[r][j + di];
                            existing.pattern = existing.pattern.add(z.multiply(C[j + di][di]));
                            existing.madness = existing.madness.add(from.madness.multiply(f[di].pattern)).add(from.pattern.multiply(f[di].madness).multiply(C[j + di][di]));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        ModularInteger answer = null;
        if (dp[n + 1][m] != null) {
            answer = dp[n + 1][m].madness;
        } else {
            answer = ModularInteger.ZERO;
        }

        pw.println(answer.val);
        pw.flush();
    }

    static class Pair {
        ModularInteger pattern;
        ModularInteger madness;

        Pair(ModularInteger pattern, ModularInteger madness) {
            this.pattern = pattern;
            this.madness = madness;
        }
    }

    static class ModularInteger {
        static int MOD;
        int value;

        ModularInteger(int v) {
            value = v % MOD;
            if (value < 0) value += MOD;
        }

        static void setMod(int m) {
            MOD = m;
        }

        static ModularInteger one = new ModularInteger(1);
        static ModularInteger zero = new ModularInteger(0);

        static ModularInteger valueOf(int v) {
            return new ModularInteger(v);
        }

        ModularInteger add(ModularInteger other) {
            int res = this.value + other.value;
            if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
            return new ModularInteger(res);
        }

        ModularInteger multiply(int other) {
            long res = (long) this.value * other % MOD;
            return new ModularInteger((int) res);
        }

        ModularInteger multiply(ModularInteger other) {
            long res = (long) this.value * other.value % MOD;
            return new ModularInteger((int) res);
        }

        ModularInteger add(int v) {
            int res = this.value + v;
            if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
            return new ModularInteger(res);
        }

        ModularInteger divide(int v) {
            return this.multiply(inv(v));
        }

        ModularInteger divide(ModularInteger v) {
            return this.multiply(inv(v.value));
        }

        static int inv(int v) {
            // Extended Euclidean Algorithm
            int a = v, b = MOD, u = 1, v2 = 0, t;
            while (b != 0) {
                int q = a / b;
                t = a % b;
                a = b;
                b = t;
                t = u - q * v2;
                u = v2;
                v2 = t;
            }
            if (u < 0) u += MOD;
            return u;
        }

        int val() {
            return value;
        }
    }
}
